declared: 2026-11-08, before the frozen rustc 1.98.0 oracle of these exact bytes and before any candidate run of these bytes. The shapes reduce census 11's record after its overlap budget (an analysis-only diagnostic census, obj/parallel/census-batch11/diagnostics/d7-postfix): "const parameter type must implement actual ConstParamTy" at core's `TransmuteFrom<Src, const ASSUME: Assume>` (mem/transmutability.rs:85-95), whose `Assume: ConstParamTy_` impl (mem/transmutability.rs:291-293) holds only under `#[unstable_feature_bound(transmutability)]`. Each outcome follows the rule read in the pinned rustc 1.98.0 sources (compiler/rustc_hir_analysis/src/check/wfcheck.rs `check_param_wf`, which registers `Ty: ConstParamTy_` under the param-env of the parameter's owner; compiler/rustc_hir_analysis/src/collect/predicates_of.rs, which adds each `#[unstable_feature_bound]` of an item to its predicates; compiler/rustc_type_ir/src/infer_ctxt.rs `may_use_unstable_feature`, which holds a feature bound when the param-env names it and otherwise, outside a staged-API crate, when the crate enables it; wfcheck.rs `check_false_global_bounds`, which proves an item's global where clauses in an empty param-env): the owner's own feature bound proves the impl's, a missing or different bound does not, and a where clause naming the trait cannot stand in for it

bound-trait.rs.reason: core's shape: `#[unstable_feature_bound(transmutability)] pub unsafe trait TransmuteFrom<Src, const ASSUME: Assume>` with `#[unstable_feature_bound(transmutability)] impl ConstParamTy_ for Assume`; the trait's environment holds the feature

unbound-trait.rs.reason: opponent: the same trait without `#[unstable_feature_bound]`; a staged-API crate never holds a feature bound by its own `#![feature]`, so `Assume: ConstParamTy_` is not proven

other-feature-trait.rs.reason: opponent: the trait's bound names `other_feature`; only the matching feature is assumed

bound-function.rs.reason: a function `#[unstable_feature_bound(transmutability)] pub fn transmute<const ASSUME: Assume>()`; its own environment holds the feature

where-clause-trait.rs.reason: opponent: the unbound trait with `where Assume: ConstParamTy_`; that global where clause must itself hold in an empty environment, and it does not
